items.stem: An AI analysis reports a strong correlation between ambient humidity and a surface defect. Before acting, what should the quality engineer do?

options.text: Check whether a plausible physical mechanism and process evidence support the link before treating it as a cause
options.rationale: Correct: correlation is a lead to investigate, not an established cause; domain evidence is needed.

options.text: Change the process immediately based on the correlation alone
options.rationale: Acting on correlation without a validated cause risks an ineffective or harmful change.

options.text: Assume the correlation is definitely the root cause
options.rationale: A found correlation is not proof of causation.

options.text: Discard the finding because AI cannot find patterns
options.rationale: The pattern is a useful lead; it simply needs verification.

items.explanation: Correct: correlation is a lead to investigate, not an established cause; domain evidence is needed.

items.stem: Which TWO practices make an AI-supported corrective action sound? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Validating the proposed change before rolling it out across the line
options.rationale: Correct: validation confirms the change actually fixes the problem without side effects.

options.text: Recording the engineer's sign-off on the change
options.rationale: Correct: accountability requires a recorded human sign-off.

options.text: Implementing the AI's suggestion directly in production with no trial
options.rationale: Unvalidated changes can make quality worse.

options.text: Ignoring the measurement-data quality behind the analysis
options.rationale: Poor measurement data can invalidate the whole analysis.

items.explanation: Correct: validation confirms the change actually fixes the problem without side effects.

items.stem: A set of control charts drafted with AI looks clean and well-presented, but the gauges used to collect the data were never calibrated. What is the risk?

options.text: The analysis may be based on unreliable measurements despite looking convincing
options.rationale: Correct: uncalibrated measurement undermines the data, regardless of how good the charts look.

options.text: None, because clean charts prove the data is good
options.rationale: Presentation quality does not validate measurement quality.

options.text: The AI will detect and fix the calibration problem itself
options.rationale: AI does not inherently detect uncalibrated measurement systems.

options.text: Calibration has no effect on quality data
options.rationale: Calibration is fundamental to trustworthy measurement data.

items.explanation: Correct: uncalibrated measurement undermines the data, regardless of how good the charts look.
